verdict.rationale: Shopify supplies building blocks that an external agent could run unattended. Order webhooks are pushed to a registered endpoint with retries (up to 8 times over 4 hours), but subscriptions are not self-serve and require contacting a partner manager. The UCP/AP2 layer lets autonomous agents transact within pre-defined, verifiable boundaries, and token-tier agents can complete checkouts directly. However, Shopify itself offers no way to define, schedule or host background automations; the user must build and run their own agent. Missing for 10: a first-party automation/scheduling or trigger-to-action builder, hosted background execution, self-serve event subscription, and hands-on evidence of an unattended end-to-end run.
